name: Giant Shuriken Stance
description: Throw massive piercing blades that repeatedly cut enemies. Gain 50% damage and throw 50% slower. Extra projectiles increase blade size. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

name: Grinding Halt
description: Each blade slows to 15% speed for 1 second on its first elite or boss hit.

name: Growing Shuriken
description: Blades grow throughout their lifetime, reaching twice their starting size.

name: Breaking Wheel
description: When a blade expires, it releases a circular slash dealing 75% blade damage. Larger blades create larger slashes.

name: Twin Wheel
description: Every fourth throw launches an additional shuriken.

name: Samurai Assist
description: Shuriken contact and burst kills have a 5% chance to call a Samurai assist.

name: Serrated Edge
description: Each blade gains 15% damage against an enemy for every previous contact hit, up to 75%. Bursts benefit from this bonus without increasing it.

name: Shuriken Damage
description: Increase blade and burst damage.
format: Increase blade and burst damage. +{Percent}% per rank.

name: Attack Speed
description: Throw shurikens more frequently.
format: Throw shurikens more frequently. +{Percent}% per rank.

name: Shuriken Size
description: Increase blade size and burst radius. With Blood Hunger, increase size gained per kill instead.
format: Increase blade size and burst radius. With Blood Hunger, increase size gained per kill instead. +{Percent}% per rank.

name: Lingering Shuriken
description: Blades last 30% longer per rank.

name: Cutting Tempo
description: Increase contact hit and pulse frequency by 15% per rank.

name: Persistent Grind
description: Grinding Halt lasts 0.2 seconds longer per rank.

name: Unstoppable Growth
description: Increase maximum blade growth by 20 percentage points per rank. Also raises Blood Hunger's growth cap.

name: Shattering Force
description: Increase expiry slash and periodic burst damage by 15% per rank.

name: Twin Frequency
description: Twin Wheel triggers one throw sooner per rank: every third, second, then every throw.

name: Reinforcements
description: Increase Samurai Assist chance by 5 percentage points per rank.

name: Deep Grooves
description: Serrated Edge gains 3 percentage points more damage per hit and a 15 percentage point higher cap per rank.

name: Bound Orbit
description: Blades orbit around you instead of flying forward, but deal 30% less contact damage. Expiry slashes are retained.

name: Blood Hunger
description: Blades start 30% smaller and grow 10% per kill, up to their growth cap. Size upgrades increase growth per kill instead of starting size. Growth resets for each blade.

name: Pulsing Core
description: Blades release a circular burst every second, but deal 35% less contact damage. Cutting Tempo speeds up bursts. Expiry slashes are retained.
